selectedFirstPackage.rationale: Single credit-facility instrument with A6-D4 PROVISIONAL_FAMILY already associated; richest Pass A candidate set; no dual-instrument indenture complication; independent must-discover pins cover core Article VII covenants.
selectedFirstPackage.scaleToOthersOnlyAfter: Independent legal review + verified-rule construction + gross-capacity evaluation succeed on Knife River with source-backed outcomes.

activationModes.when: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY provided AND explicit spend authorization recorded
steps: Confirm budget ceiling and model identity with Coordinator
Run Pass B–D discovery for Knife River operative base only (Agent 1 eligibility still NOT_EXECUTABLE until verify)
Legal interpretation / semantic compile for must-discover + audit-flagged restriction sections
Independent legal review checklist (human or designated reviewer) against source excerpts
certifyCandidate only when gates pass — never invent CERTIFIED
Gross-capacity evaluateVerifiedCapacity under REQUIRE with empty utilization ledger if needed
Withhold remaining capacity until APPROVED financials + complete utilization evidence (Agent 2)
stopConditions: Any REVIEW_REQUIRED / cross-rule gate → refuse, do not force executable
PROVISIONAL_FAMILY amendments → do not consolidate operative text without confirmed chain

activationModes.when: Sealed offline fixtures / replay corpus authorized for the target package
steps: Locate approved replay artifacts (none currently exist for Knife River / Insulet / Benchmark)
Replay only sealed provider transcripts — never invent completions
Same verification and capacity gates as live path
activationModes.note: CONMED Phase-3 packets are a separate authentic path, not a substitute for unseen-package interpretation.

failureClassReporting.OPERATIONAL_AUTHORIZATION: Keys present but spend not authorized
failureClassReporting.SUBSTANTIVE_LEGAL_INTERPRETATION: Model/reviewer produced an interpretation that fails closed on legal grounds
failureClassReporting.CASCADE_FROM_UPSTREAM: Stage not reached because an upstream operational block prevented work

agent1Coordination.rule: Pass A SIGNAL_ONLY_NOT_EXECUTABLE — candidates never become executable merely because Pass A identified them

prohibited: Treat PROVISIONAL_FAMILY as confirmed operative consolidation
